purpose: Discriminate interference from dense technical metadata versus inability to bind attributes, after the wording-only hypothesis failed. No product change is selected in advance.
variables: Use original fixed prefix and same facts, instruction, question, client, model and effort. text-first preserves every JSON field and value but moves text first within each record. text-only keeps just records/text as a causal ablation.

productEligibility.text-first: Only if all targeted trials, controls and independent prose review pass; still requires rebuilt-binary qualification.

limits: text-only removes provenance/feedback refs and is never a deployable fix. A pass there can diagnose metadata effects but never satisfy product acceptance. No score-only conclusion; retain and review all answers.
integrity: All33 threads unique; no tool calls, paid API, real memory, config changes, answer replacement or model substitution.
ordering: Rotate conditions per case/trial; at most3 independent groups overlap.
interpretation: Failures on q08/q09/q11 must be inspected individually. A hypothesis is weakened if the same field error persists in the text-only ablation. No predetermined success outcome.
